[RTCT.6.7.4] **packed.** When `node_caps_packed` is non-empty,
`default_node_cap` MUST be 0 and `node_overrides` empty. The
array has exactly `node_count` entries; the *i*-th entry is the
capacity of the *i*-th covered node in the ascending
enumeration of [RTCT.6.7.2]. A length ≠ `node_count` is
`DS_ERR_CONTRACT_INVALID`.
